items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Chubb - Steinberg--- and this was a band owned by two men... Chubb and Steinberg... the fellow that came to hear me was the leader of the band - was a guy named Art Hicks

ctx.x: Yeah - Chubb - Steinberg--- and this was a band owned by two men who had a music store in Cincinnati and everybody thought that this ChubbSteinberg was one guy's name - but it was really two. Chubb and Steinberg.

Yeah - I think so. Yeah, well, anyway -- uh, the fellow that came to hear me was the leader of the band - was a guy named Art Hicks and he came to listen to me play that night and I did my comedy number and all those little things that I did and he said-- well, he said - if you want the job, it's yours. And, so, when he told me how much I was going to get, I couldn't believe that either - I think $50.00 a week. I said - are you kidding - that is really--- fancy money, you know, in those days.
